title: Ray-Tracing-Based Dynamic Channel Sounding With Autoregressive Wi-Fi CSI Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.05970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Channel sounding in Wi-Fi multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems must balance channel state information (CSI) accuracy against CSI acquisition overhead. Device mobility causes channel aging, while autoregressive CSI prediction introduces errors that accumulate over sounding intervals. However, standardized statistical channel models cannot fully capture the environment-specific channel dynamics encountered in physical artificial intelligence (AI) applications, motivating the use of Sionna-based ray tracing to evaluate CSI prediction under device mobility and evolving propagation geometry. This paper develops a dynamic sounding framework that integrates autoregressive CSI prediction with signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR)-constrained interval selection. A Transformer with rotary position embedding that converts device positions into CSI sequences predicts CSI across multiple subcarriers for beamforming updates between

translated_title: 基于射线追踪的动态信道探测与自回归Wi-Fi信道状态信息预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.05970v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：Wi-Fi多输入多输出（MIMO）系统中的信道探测必须在信道状态信息（CSI）精度与CSI获取开销之间取得平衡。设备的移动会导致信道老化，而自回归CSI预测会引入随探测间隔不断累积的误差。然而，标准化的统计信道模型无法完全捕捉物理人工智能应用中所遇到的特定环境的信道动态，这促使我们采用基于Sionna的射线追踪来评估设备移动与传播几何结构演变情况下的CSI预测。本文开发了一种动态信道探测框架，将自回归CSI预测与信干噪比（SINR）约束的探测间隔选择相结合。该框架利用带有旋转位置编码的Transformer，将设备位置转换为CSI序列，在多个子载波上预测CSI，用于探测间隔之间的波束成形更新。
tldr: 本文提出一种将自回归CSI预测与SINR约束探测间隔选择相结合的动态信道探测框架，并利用基于Sionna射线追踪的环境建模和带旋转位置编码的Transformer来应对Wi-Fi MIMO系统中设备移动导致的信道老化与预测误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamic channel sounding framework integrating autoregressive CSI prediction with SINR-constrained interval selection, leveraging Sionna-based ray tracing and a rotary-position-embedding Transformer to mitigate channel aging and prediction error accumulation caused by device mobility in Wi-Fi MIMO systems.
